ops.title: Project exact touch inputs without unused ToolUse payloads
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_related_topk_ship. Source confirms Capt touch_of uses only call.name, call.raw mapping, preferred structured tool_use_result (otherwise content), and result_ts-or-ts. ToolUseWire also transfers edits, turn metadata, both result payload representations and typed ToolCall data. Do not remove the full raw/result information Touch actually uses. Next: build a bounded CI baseline with a large unused content field plus small preferred structured result; then implement a lossless borrowed touch-input projection and owned codec, preserving IDs, first-rank/last-ID winner, ordering, timestamps, error inclusion and custom/Codex routes. No current physical host-pressure attribution is claimed. Evidence: captain_hook/tickets/context.py:407-415 in capt-ticket-touch-projection and rust/crates/core/src/snapshot_codec.rs:95-135 in cc-transcript-interaction-wire.

ops.text: Real CI reproduces old extra wire/copy cost on selected large unused content; the complete old Touch tuple is the independent oracle.
Borrowed native projection and owned decoder preserve every used raw/result value, timestamp, ID/order/window/error contract; no truncation, fallback or existing ToolUse API change.
Independent review and CI pass; merge, public SDK/Capt releases, guarded local installation and affected-operation byte/work verification complete before done.
